root_idea.summary: The root centers on enclosing or surrounding something from all around it, and hence on circular movement, turning, circulation, and what comes around or encompasses.
root_idea.development: From the basic idea of surrounding arise movement in a circle, recurrence and circulation, circumferential forms, adverse circumstances that envelop people, and places or communities understood as a dwelling or bounded domain.

senses.definition: To turn, revolve, or move around; to circle.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic Form I imperfect usage describing circular or revolving movement.

senses.definition: To circulate or pass something back and forth between people; to give and take it from hand to hand.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic commercial construction, the merchandise is present and exchanged between the parties without deferral.

senses.definition: A turn of fortune, especially an adverse turn, calamity, or misfortune that overtakes and envelops people.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic expressions دائرة السوء and الدوائر refer to harmful circumstances or reversals of fortune; the plural form denotes such turns collectively.

senses.definition: A house, home, or place of residence; a dwelling or group of dwellings.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes Quranic singular and plural forms, including دِيَار, when referring to people's houses or inhabited residences.

senses.definition: An abode, domain, or established dwelling-place, including a worldly or hereafter realm.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in Quranic expressions such as the abode of this world, the Hereafter, peace, or the transgressors; the meaning is determined by the accompanying qualifier and context.

senses.definition: An inhabitant or resident; a person dwelling in a place.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence appears in a negative construction meaning that no inhabitant or resident is to be left.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To circulate or go around among people or objects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes things passed around from one person to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a celestial sphere or firmament, to revolve in its orbit or about its axis.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized application of circular movement to the heavens.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reason in a circle, with propositions depending circularly upon one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative technical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For days, time, fortune, or an event to come round, recur, or come about.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of temporal cycles and changing circumstances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seem to turn around a person suffering vertigo or giddiness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the relevant preposition of the ground, sea, or surrounding scene.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To comprehend, encompass, or have something within one's power, compass, or care.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of surrounding; it may describe authority over people or control of an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To court, dally with, or hold amorous converse with someone under one's power or care.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative construction involving an amorous relation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something round, circular, or spherical.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn thoughts or opinions over in the mind concerning an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form II use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go round about with someone or accompany someone in circular movement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Equivalent to going round with the person concerned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To circumvent someone or seek to outmaneuver game by attending to its movements and sounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The hunting use describes skill in tracking and circumventing prey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To try to turn or incline someone toward or away from an affair, sometimes by deceit or guile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may take عن for turning someone away or على for turning someone toward something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To work at, manage, or seek the methods of carrying out affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal noun denotes sustained exertion in handling or accomplishing affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone or something go, move, turn, circle, or return around; to wind or stir something around.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Examples include winding a turban around the head and stirring saffron in water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to experience vertigo or giddiness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive and prepositional constructions describe being made to turn or being affected by vertigo.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To endeavor to induce someone to do something or to leave it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may express turning someone toward an affair or away from it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a place as a house or abode.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form V verb applies to settling in or treating a place as a dwelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become or assume a round or circular form; to become coiled or full.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used, for example, of the moon becoming full or a thing winding around another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A burial-ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived application of دار to a place where people are laid to rest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A country, district, city, town, or village considered as an inhabited domain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader territorial use distinct from the concrete house or dwelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The City of the Prophet, Medina, when used with the definite article.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional proper-name use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tribe or people understood as the inhabitants of one house or domain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative collective use, as in the tribe of a named family.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The circumference of a circle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal derivative referring to the extent of circular movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A turn or twist of a turban, rope, or similar elongated object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to one winding or revolution in wrapping or twisting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A Christian convent or monastery, including a monk's cloister or cell.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized place-name branch associated with a monastic dwelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The head or chief of a group of companions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative use of the head of a monastery.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The halo or circular ring around the moon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized circumferential sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A round space or tract of sand, sometimes with an open space in the middle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place may be used as a gathering place where people sit and drink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wide plain or open tract of land enclosed or surrounded by mountains or sands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The terrain may be soft and level or somewhat rugged, depending on the usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place surrounded and confined by something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general spatial use of enclosure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A determinate nominal use distinct from the Quranic noun دائرة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who remains in his house and scarcely leaves it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense emphasizes staying at home rather than seeking sustenance elsewhere.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A possessor of life's blessings, comforts, or conveniences.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of one who remains established in a house.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel, sheep, or goat that remains at the house or stays behind instead of going to pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a domestic animal that remains where the others lie down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sailor responsible for handling the sail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized occupational use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of perfumes or perfumer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional attribution associated with Dārīn and its perfume market.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The master or an inhabitant of a convent or monastery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational noun from دَيْرٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vertigo or giddiness in the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The vocalized noun denotes the condition itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An idol, stone, or the circular space around it, used for ritual circumambulation; the term was also applied to the Kaaba.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a pre-Islamic or conventional cultic use involving circling a sacred object or space.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A circling tract of sand around which wild animals move.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A landscape term for a circular sandy area.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Turning, circling, or revolving, especially when applied to the firmament.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive adjectival description of circular celestial motion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Turning people repeatedly from one state or condition to another, said of time or fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of the recurrent changes imposed by time or fortune.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of wood turned by water so that it makes a mill turn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical implement sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pair of compasses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tool named for its circular movement or function.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A round part or portion of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The coiled or circularly formed intestines or guts of a sheep or goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical and culinary-animal use concerning the belly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A round object that moves or turns around.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Contrasted with a similar form used for something round that does not move.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The circuit, compass, ambit, circumference, ring, or round boundary of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the surrounding parts of the hoof or face and ordinary circular or ring-shaped objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The circular or spiral curl of hair on the crown of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical and idiomatic use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A naturally curled or spirally arranged feather or patch of hair on a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to one of the recognized hair whorls on a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The round depression or protuberance beneath the nose or in the middle of the upper lip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A precise anatomical use with variant terms for the two locations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stake fixed in the middle of a heap of grain around which cattle turn while treading it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agricultural implement sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sitting-place or place of assembly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use distinct from the circular-land sense referenced elsewhere.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The axis or orbital center of the firmament or celestial sphere.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive use of the verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The point or matter upon which a question or affair turns.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative technical use; plural مدارَات denotes such focal points.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person affected by vertigo or giddiness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression مَدُورٌ بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rounded, sewn skin bucket used for drawing water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical container sense; a variant interpretation connects the word with managing or passing buckets.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment decorated with various circles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A textile use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: She-camels around which the herder goes in order to milk them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term for animals approached in a circuit during milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Round, circular, spherical, or having assumed a rounded form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The two explicitly cross-referenced adjectival forms describe rounded shape; one example applies the sense to a full moon.

cautions: The Quranic form دَيَّارٌ is presented with the general lexical sense inhabitant; its Quranic context is a negative construction, while broader Classical usage is not restricted to negation.
دَارٌ encompasses both concrete homes and qualified abodes or domains in Quranic usage; the plural forms دِيَارٌ and دُورٌ are included under the same public noun.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:dwr:1570:g2:main reports a tentative meaning of دَارٌ as 'a year' or 'a long period'; the evidence itself questions the attribution, so it is left unassigned.
